remarks:
This remarkable contemporary home offers spectacular panoramic water views, an original boathouse, and an expansive yard perfect for entertaining, recreation, or simply enjoying the peaceful lakeside setting.

Designed with an impressive open floor plan, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence showcases soaring vaulted ceilings accented by exposed wood beams, rich hardwood flooring, and an expansive great room centered around a stunning floor-to-ceiling brick fireplace with a raised hearth. The modern kitchen overlooks the main living space, creating the ideal layout for gathering with family and friends while enjoying incredible lake views.

Two loft areas overlook the great room, providing flexible living space for home offices, reading areas, or additional guest accommodations. The spacious enclosed porch/sunroom serves as the perfect four-season retreat, offering uninterrupted views of Lake Ontario and seamless indoor-outdoor living.

Outside, the property continues to impress with a 48' x 22' detached workshop, ideal for hobbyists, craftsmen, or additional storage, along with a 2.5-car attached garage. A 200-amp electrical service with a Generac whole-house generator provides peace of mind year-round.

The full, dry basement features quality mechanical systems and abundant storage, offering endless possibilities for future finishing or workshop space.

Desirable location adjacent to Golden Hill State Park, offering public spaces to hike and explore right next door. Whether you're searching for a year-round residence or an extraordinary waterfront getaway, this one-of-a-kind property combines architectural character, modern comforts, and unmatched Lake Ontario frontage in one exceptional offering.
